observations: Photo shows a reddish-orange gas cylinder lying in a car trunk/boot, surrounded by unrelated household items.
Cylinder has visible surface rust and paint wear across the body.
A metal valve assembly with a knob is seen at the top of the cylinder.
No manufacturer name, capacity stamp, serial number, or test/certification date is legible anywhere on the cylinder.
Watermark reads 'POSTED ON JIJI NWOBODO PETER', confirming marketplace listing origin, not product authenticity.
No certificate, test report, or close-up of the valve/collar stampings is shown.
Seller's new message is a verbal reassurance only; no new photo, document, or video was provided.

claims.evidence: No capacity stamp visible on the cylinder collar in photo 0; size is assumed from seller's words only.
No import markings, country-of-origin stamp, or paperwork shown in photo 0.
Seller now insists verbally ('I tested it myself yesterday') but still no certificate, sticker, or stamp shown in any photo.
Leak testing cannot be assessed from a static photo; no soap-bubble test, gauge reading, or video provided despite the reassurance.
Valve is visible in photo 0 but shows no distinguishing marks confirming it is newly installed; seller's reply adds no visual proof.

risks.risk: Cylinder may be past its safety re-test/revalidation date, which is critical for pressurized gas vessels.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the stamped manufacture/test date ring on the cylinder neck or collar.
risks.if_unproven: priced as due for re-test / not currently certified

risks.risk: Actual water capacity may not be 20kg as claimed.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the stamped capacity (kg or litre water capacity) on the collar.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified capacity, assume smaller/standard size risk

risks.risk: Visible rust could indicate thinning metal or corrosion risk, affecting safe use.
risks.proof: Multiple angle photos showing full body condition and any pitting or dents.
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetically and structurally worn, lower than 'good condition' tier

risks.risk: Valve could be old, leaking, or incompatible with regulator despite claim of being new.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of valve brand stamp and a video/photo of a leak test (soap bubble or gauge) being performed.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not confirmed leak-free, worst case requiring valve replacement

risks.risk: No certification document or test authority stamp shown, so 'tested and certified' claim cannot be cross-checked; a self-reported test by the seller is not independent verification.
risks.proof: Photo of the certification document/sticker with test center name and date, or a timestamped video of the actual leak test.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the cylinder collar showing stamped manufacture date, capacity, and last test date.
Photo or copy of the recent testing/certification document mentioned by the seller.
Close-up photo of the valve showing brand/model markings.
Short video of a leak test (soap bubble test) being performed on the valve and seams.
Additional photos from other angles showing the full body for rust/dents.
response.reason: A seller's unverified verbal reassurance without any new photo, document, or video does not change the evidence on record, so the cylinder remains priced at worst case as an uncertified, unverified-condition used 20kg-class cylinder.
